unit: dataset; paired accuracy differences averaged across resamples 1,2,3
primary_gate: one-sided paired-difference t test against -0.3 pp plus two-sided dataset-bootstrap 95% lower bound above -0.3 pp
hierarchical_sensitivity: resample datasets, then resample three accuracy splits independently within each sampled dataset; report separately, do not use to tune configuration
claim: no loss within the prespecified margin if gate passes; no claim of a gain
